document_metadata.document_title: Harris County Low Impact Development & Green Infrastructure Design Criteria for Storm Water Management

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Projects exceeding one acre require a Storm Water Quality (SWQ) Permit and SWQMP; treat the first 1 inch of runoff. LID IMPs (bioretention, vegetated swales, permeable pavement, rainwater harvesting, green roofs, filter strips, planters, tree box filters) may satisfy quality and detention credits per Table 1. Conventional gravity detention minimum rate 0.55 ac-ft per acre (Table 3); LID projects may use reduced detention with approved low-impact approach.
peak_flow_calculation_method: Detention and hydrograph matching per HCPID-AED / HCFCD requirements
Minimum detention 0.55 ac-ft/acre for gravity systems
approved_bmp_categories: Disconnection of roof runoff and impervious surfaces
